newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ridley says will not raise White bid.
newsitem.headline: Ridley says will not raise White bid.

text.p: Stockfeed producer Ridley Corp Ltd said on Monday it would not raise the takeover offer for maltster Joe White Maltings Ltd which closes on November 8.
Ridley is offering cash A$5.44 per share, made up of A$5.30 a share plus 14 cents a share dividend.
Ridley had tried to raise the offer to an effective A$5.90 a share via the introduction of a scrip component, conditional on a favourable recomendation from the Joe White board.
However on October 18, the Joe White board said such a recommendation would not be forthcoming.
Joe White shares closed 10 cents higher at A$5.60 on Monday.
"Ridley believes many Joe White shareholders will share its disappointment at the refusal of the board of Joe White to work towards making the cash and share offer a reality," Ridley said.
"Nevertheless, Ridley, with its 18 percent shareholding in Joe White, looks forward to working with shareholders in enhancing the value of Joe White," it said.
Ridley also urged Joe White shareholders to elect the two Ridley directors nominated for election to the White board at White's annual meeting on Wednesday.
Ridley said it had not declared its offer free of any conditions.
